verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents its own session observability (rich logs, live view, session replay) and registrable webhooks that POST to your endpoint when subscribed events occur. Together these give a data engineer job monitoring and programmatic status notifications. Nothing in the pack covers validating the quality of extracted data, and the webhooks are not explicitly documented as firing on job failure. Missing for 10: data-quality validation capability, explicit failure-event alerting, job performance metrics or dashboards beyond session logs and replay, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails

citations.quote: best-in-class observability (rich logs, live view, and session replay)
Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.
Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
Run agents that click through your product continuously and alert you the moment something breaks.
